quote: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
author: Robert Arnott

quote: The four most dangerous words in investing are: 'this time it's different.'
author: Sir John Templeton

quote: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: It's not whether you're right or wrong that's important, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
author: George Soros

quote: Know what you own, and know why you own it.
author: Peter Lynch

quote: The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
author: Charlie Munger

quote: Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world. He who understands it, earns it; he who doesn't, pays it.
author: Often attributed to Albert Einstein

quote: A budget is telling your money where to go, instead of wondering where it went.
author: Dave Ramsey

quote: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The goal isn't more money. The goal is living life on your own terms.
author: Chris Brogan

quote: Never depend on a single income. Make an investment to create a second source.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: You get recessions, you have stock market declines. If you don't understand that's going to happen, you're not ready, you won't do well in the markets.
author: Peter Lynch

quote: It's not your salary that makes you rich, it's your spending habits.
author: Charles A. Jaffe

quote: Financial freedom is available to those who learn about it and work for it.
author: Robert Kiyosaki

quote: The individual investor should act consistently as an investor and not as a speculator.
author: Benjamin Graham

quote: Time in the market beats timing the market.
author: Common investing adage

quote: Diversification is protection against ignorance.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Wide diversification is only required when investors do not understand what they are doing.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Someone's sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The most important quality for an investor is temperament, not intellect.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Money is a terrible master but an excellent servant.
author: P.T. Barnum

quote: If you don't know who you are, the stock market is an expensive place to find out.
author: George Goodman (Adam Smith)

quote: The four most important words in investing are 'margin of safety.'
author: Seth Klarman

quote: Markets can remain irrational longer than you can remain solvent.
author: John Maynard Keynes

quote: Never test the depth of the water with both feet.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Rule No. 1 is never lose money. Rule No. 2 is never forget rule No. 1.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The investor's chief problem — and even his worst enemy — is likely to be himself.
author: Benjamin Graham
